Command.Comment: RAGIN EDGE cowrie config and home tree

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo COWRIE_CFG
if [ -f /etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg ]; then
  echo FILE=/etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg
  echo SIZE_BYTES=$(stat -c %s /etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg 2>/dev/null || echo stat_failed)
  echo LINE_COUNT=$(wc -l < /etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg 2>/dev/null || echo wc_failed)
  echo SECTION_HEADERS=$(grep -nE '^\s*\[|\s*enabled\s*=\s*true' /etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg 2>/dev/null | head -n 80 || echo grep_failed)
else
  echo FILE_MISSING=/etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg
fi
echo COWRIE_HOME_TREE
if [ -d /cowrie ]; then
  echo COWRIE_HOME=/cowrie
  find /cowrie -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -n 120
else
  echo COWRIE_HOME_MISSING=/cowrie
fi
echo COWRIE_PID_or_SOCK_check
if [ -f /cowrie/cowrie.pid ]; then echo PID_FILE=/cowrie/cowrie.pid; else echo PID_MISSING; fi
echo DONE
